cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Description
cl.x: Sika® MultiSeal BT is a self-adhesive sealing tape based on a butyl rubber compound reinforced with an aluminium film. High tack butyl adhesive ensures reliable, durable long term bonding to a wide range of substrates in internal and external applications.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Uses
cl.l: The Sika® MultiSeal BT is used for repairing, protecting and sealing:
s: Sheet metal roofs
Facade elements
Concrete roof tiles
Gutters and down pipes in metal and PVC
Chimneys and sky lights
Caravans and containers
Modular buildings and office containers
Ductwork for ventilation and air condition
Dampening and insulation

cl.x: Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.6.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Packaging
Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Storage conditions
cl.x: The Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +25 °C. Always refer to packaging. Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage.

Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 04.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
s: The substrate must be sound, clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, cement laitance, old sealants and poorly bonded coatings which could affect adhesion of the tape. The substrate must be of sufficient strength to cope with the stresses induced by the tape during movement.
For optimal adhesion, the following procedure is recommended.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Non-Porous Substrates
cl.x: Clean and pre-treat the substrate with Sika® Aktivator-205 applied with a clean towel. Allow a flash-off time > 10 min (max. 2 hours) before applying the tape.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Non-Porous Substrates > POROUS SUBSTRATES
cl.x: Use hot air to pre-heat concrete, aerated concrete and cementitious plasters, mortars and brick substrates to increase adhesion.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 04.01) and the requirements below.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Product Information
s: Thickness: Including film 1.0 mm (EN 1849-1)

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools
cl.x: Cut the tape to required length, remove the release liner and press the tape firmly onto the prepared substrate with a hard wheel roller or suitable tool. All joints and connections must be overlapped by a minimum of 50mm. Low temperatures can reduce adhesion, warm the tape and substrate using a hot air blower for a few minutes prior to application.

cl.t: Application method / tools - Overpainting the tape
cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools > OVERPAINTING THE TAPE
cl.x: The top aluminium film side of the Product can be overpainted with most conventional paint coating systems. Do not use solvent-based paints. Test the compatability of the paint coating with the Product before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Clean all tools and application equipment immediately after use with petroleum or turpentine. Once cured, hardened material can only be removed mechanically. For cleaning skin use Sika® Cleaning Wipes-100 and wash with water and soap.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Limitations Of Use
s: Do not use on natural stone substrates.
Due to the chemical content of the tape, coatings and plastics may discolour, test for compatability prior to any use.
Not suitable for sealing against water pressure.
Not suitable as a permanent fixing and in load bearing applications.
Not suitable for permanently immersed applications.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Important Considerations
s: Butyl adhesives are sensitive to solvents, check for chemical compatability befor use.

On porous substrates, water infiltration underneath the tape is possible which may affect adhesion. Thoroughly dry out substrates before applying the Product. Plasticiser migration from the Product may result in reduced adhesion, surface discolouration, or surface tackiness. Test the compatibility of the Product with the substrate before application.
